description: Shortcut for the latest silver (XAG) rate, with bid/ask, without needing to pass a symbols list. Use 'include' to add a per-gram, per-tola, or per-carat breakdown. Set 'metadata' to false to omit the unit/quote map.

include.description: Add a per-unit breakdown alongside the per-troy-ounce rate: 'gram' adds a per-gram rate, 'tola' adds a per-tola rate, 'carat' adds per-gram rates at each purity from 24k down to 8k. Omit for the ounce rate only.

metadata.description: Whether to include the 'metadata' map (per-symbol unit and quote currency) in the response. Defaults to true. Set false to omit it and get a smaller payload.

quote.description: Target quote currency code (e.g. 'USD', 'EUR'). Premium/Plus plans only; omit to use each symbol's default currency.

name: get_silver_price
title: Get latest silver (XAG) price
